copy.tagline: Grow the snake, miss the walls, keep the pace.
copy.description: Classic snake, only faster and meaner. The tempo climbs every five apples, and short-lived bonuses decide the leaderboard. One wrong turn on one tile ends the run.
controls: Turn with the arrow keys or WASD.
On a touch screen, swipe the way you want to go.
Each apple is worth 10 points, a short-lived bonus 50.
